svg.aria-label: Office LAN: site-to-site VPN and link failover
svg.title: Office LAN: site-to-site VPN and link failover
svg.desc: 1. Printing from a wired PC 2. Opening the file server over Wi-Fi 3. Reaching the file server from the branch 4. Nightly backup to the data center 5. The fiber link fails and the VPN drops 6. Automatic failover to LTE 7. The fiber link recovers

g.text: The PC sends the print data to the floor switch
The switch reads the destination MAC address
and forwards to the printer's port only
The tablet joins the office SSID over encrypted Wi-Fi
Wireless frames are bridged to the wired LAN
Tagged frames are forwarded to the core switch
and reads from the file server
Traffic for the head office goes to the branch router
IPsec encrypts it and sends it over the internet
The UTM at the head office ends the tunnel and decrypts
Only traffic allowed by policy enters the LAN
The file server's response returns the same way
Forwards to the UTM on the backup VLAN
Encrypts and sends toward the data center
Keepalive replies stop, so the UTM declares the link down
The default route moves to the LTE router
The VPN is negotiated again over the mobile link
The tunnel to the branch router is back
Confirms the main link and moves the route back
The tunnel returns to the fiber link
Traffic on one floor stays inside the floor switch, and never reaches the core switch or the UTM.
Opening the file server over Wi-Fi
The tablet reaches the file server through the access point, the floor switch and the core switch.
Reaching the file server from the branch
A PC at the branch uses the file server on the head office LAN through the site-to-site VPN.
Nightly backup to the data center
At night, changes on the file server are copied to the data center over the VPN.
The fiber link fails and the VPN drops
The UTM detects the failure. Traffic to the branch and data center stops, while the office LAN keeps
The UTM routes through the LTE router and rebuilds the VPN. Backups stay paused because the
With the main link back, the route returns to it and LTE goes back on standby. Paused backups
